title: Ansel and the Autopsy
author: Zephyrine Nystrom
blurb: Elodie Halloran, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
